title: Lunar Field Expedition
niche: Earth and space science, research skills
audience: Grades 9-12 earth/space science; intro undergraduate geology; EdTech learning designers; museums
summary: Land at the real Apollo 15 Hadley-Apennine site, rebuilt from NASA's LROC terrain data. Read the landscape under changing sunlight, compare surface ages with crater counts, plan a sampling traverse within EVA limits, and defend your findings in a claim-evidence-reasoning field report compared with the real Apollo 15 traverse.

poster.alt: Low sun over the cratered lunar plain at the Apollo 15 site, rebuilt from NASA terrain data: rounded hills on the left, a long dark shadow across the ground on the right, and a black, star-dotted sky.
